PART I

ITEM 1. Business

The Company was founded in 1994 and is a leading provider of industrial widgets. It operates three manufacturing facilities and employs approximately 4,200 people worldwide. Customers rely on the Company for products and services that the Company designs, develops and sells throughout the world.

ITEM 1A. Risk Factors

Investors should note the following risk factors, which could materially affect the results of the Company. The Company operates in a competitive industry and its results may differ materially from those expressed or implied by forward-looking statements.
